# --- 枚举定义 ---

class TaskStatus(str, Enum):
    TODO = "TODO"
    IN_PROGRESS = "IN_PROGRESS"
    DONE = "DONE"

class Priority(str, Enum):
    LOW = "LOW"
    MEDIUM = "MEDIUM"
    HIGH = "HIGH"
    URGENT = "URGENT"

# --- 请求/响应 DTO ---

class TaskCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    title: str                          # 标题（必填，1-200字）
    description: str | None = None      # 描述
    priority: Priority = Priority.MEDIUM
    due_date: date | None = None
    assignee_id: UUID | None = None     # 分配用户
    tag_ids: list[UUID] = []            # 关联标签

class TaskUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    title: str | None = None
    description: str | None = None
    priority: Priority | None = None
    due_date: date | None = None
    assignee_id: UUID | None = None

class TaskSearchParams(BaseModel):
    keyword: str | None = None          # 全文检索关键词
    status: TaskStatus | None = None
    priority: Priority | None = None
    tag_ids: list[UUID] = []
    assignee_id: UUID | None = None
    created_by: UUID | None = None
    due_date_from: date | None = None
    due_date_to: date | None = None
    created_at_from: datetime | None = None
    created_at_to: datetime | None = None
    page: int = 1
    page_size: int = 20
    sort_by: str = "created_at"         # created_at | due_date | priority
    sort_order: str = "desc"            # asc | desc

class TaskResponse(BaseModel):
    id: UUID
    title: str
    description: str | None
    status: TaskStatus
    priority: Priority
    due_date: date | None
    created_by: UUID
    assignee: UserBrief | None
    tags: list[TagBrief]
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime

# --- REST API 接口 ---

POST   /api/v1/tasks                          → create_task(req: TaskCreateRequest) → TaskResponse
